info.name: Restful Booker API Testing Portfolio
info.description:
Portfolio collection for REST API testing of the Restful Booker  
demonstration API.

Coverage includes:

- API health check
    
- Valid and invalid authentication
    
- Booking creation
    
- Required-field validation
    
- Boundary-value testing
    
- Booking retrieval
    
- Booking search
    
- Full booking update
    
- Partial booking update
    
- Authorization testing
    
- Booking deletion
    
- Nonexistent booking handling
    
- Status-code assertions
    
- Response-body assertions
    
- Response-time assertions
    

Important limitation:

Restful Booker is a public demonstration API that resets its booking  
records regularly. The API is not connected to the local PostgreSQL  
portfolio database.
